an interactive h9k task queue or h9k task assign (with --take, or without it where the door already offers a take) reads the linked item assigned to another person, it names that person as the tracker shows them and asks whether to reassign the item to the operator, defaulting to no; on yes it reads the item fresh again and, only if the same holder is still there, writes the operator\\u0027s own tracker identity through the tracker API, reads it back, and proceeds exactly as a take does; on no it warns and proceeds as today\u0022,\u0022The offer is made only where a human is at the terminal: a non-interactive run, the dispatcher\\u0027s claim and mirror sweeps, a dispatched session, and an orchestrator session never reassign, and a non-interactive --take on a held item refuses exactly as today\u0022,\u0022No reassignment is offered when the task\\u0027s ledger holder is another node (TaskAggregate.HolderNodeId names a node other than this one): the refusal names that node and points at the cooperative take, h9k task take \\u003Cid\\u003E --reason \\u0022\\u003Cwhy\\u003E\\u0022, whose grant moves the tracker assignment\u0022,\u0022A fresh read whose holder differs from the one named in the question writes nothing and says who holds the item now\u0022,\u0022The reassignment is recorded on the task\\u0027s stream as its own event carrying who was replaced (identity and name as the tracker showed them), who replaced them, the reference, and when it was read back; h9k task show renders it\u0022,\u0022It works for every gated tracker: Linear and Jira overwrite the single assignee; on GitHub every current assignee is removed and the operator added, so the read-back shows the operator alone, and a read-back that still names anybody else refuses as Contested with nothing recorded\u0022,\u0022The item\\u0027s state, labels, and other fields are untouched; the write is an assignee field update only\u0022,\u0022The --take help text, the refusal sentences, and the CLI reference skill no longer say that no flag takes an item from another person; they say an interactive confirm can, and that nothing unattended does\u0022,\u0022Every tracker call in these tests runs against recorded responses, and the offer, its decline, and its acceptance are pinned through the existing TakeOffer seam without a console\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-30T12:26:15.820157\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"0101b902-00cc-4305-b731-306859bba004","originSequence":145461,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-30T12:26:15.833086+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"},{"streamId":"01a1881c-08d6-711f-9733-4b79c75fb837","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1881c-08d6-711f-9733-4b79c75fb837\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022In a project with --claim-gate tracker-assignee, when an attended h9k task queue (with or without --take) or h9k task assign --take reads the linked item assigned to another person, it names every current holder as the tracker shows them, with each name escaped for the console, and asks whether to reassign the item to the operator, defaulting to no; h9k task assign without --take still reads no tracker and offers nothing\u0022,\u0022On no, nothing is written: a run with --take refuses with exit 70 and leaves the task unchanged, and h9k task queue without --take warns and queues, both as they do today\u0022,\u0022A task already Queued or Blocked for this operator reaches the same offer through an attended h9k task queue \\u003Cid\\u003E: on yes it stays in the queue with its rank and placement, and neither TaskAssigned nor TaskUnassigned is appended; every other h9k task queue on a queued task, and every unattended one, gets today\\u0027s already-queued refusal unchanged\u0022,\u0022On yes, a new write path, separate from TrackerAssignmentTake.TakeAsync, reads the item fresh; only if the same holders are there, compared by identity with the tracker\\u0027s own comparison, it writes the operator\\u0027s own tracker identity, reads it back, and the door proceeds as a successful take does; TakeAsync itself keeps refusing a held item, so the dispatcher\\u0027s claim and mirror sweeps and h9k task take --force never reassign\u0022,\u0022A fresh read that shows anything else writes nothing, exits 70, leaves the task unchanged, and says who holds the item now\u0022,\u0022Attended means stdin, stdout, and stderr are all terminals (Capabilities.Interactive) and none of HALL9K_DISPATCHED_RUN_ID, HALL9K_DETACHED_SESSION, or CLAUDE_PID is set; a test pins each variable through an injected environment reader; an unattended run, a dispatched session, and an orchestrator session get no reassign offer, and an unattended --take on a held item refuses exactly as today; a project with the claim gate off is untouched\u0022,\u0022No reassignment is offered when TaskAggregate.HolderNodeId names a node other than this one: the door behaves as an unattended run does, and its line also names that node and points at the cooperative take, h9k task take \\u003Cid\\u003E --reason \\u0022\\u003Cwhy\\u003E\\u0022; a test pins this with a task whose holder was never released\u0022,\u0022The reassignment is recorded on the task\\u0027s stream as its own event, in place of TrackerAssignmentWritten, carrying every replaced holder (identity and name as the tracker showed them, never an email), the operator\\u0027s identity and name from the read-back, the reference, and when it was read back; the event is registered ProjectScoped and MemberSafe, and h9k task show renders it with the names as relayed text\u0022,\u0022It works for every gated tracker: Linear and Jira overwrite the single assignee, and GitHub makes one gh issue edit call carrying --add-assignee for the operator and --remove-assignee for every holder, pinned by a test over the generated arguments, so a write that fails leaves the holders where they were; a read-back showing the operator alone passes, one showing the operator and anybody else refuses as Contested, one not showing the operator refuses as Unconfirmed, neither records the event, and both say in their own sentence that the previous holders may be gone from the item; a refused write quotes the tracker\\u0027s own words, exits 70, and leaves the task unchanged\u0022,\u0022TrackerClaimDecision\\u0027s HeldByOther RefusalLine and ReasonLine say that h9k task queue at a terminal offers to reassign the item, so h9k status, h9k task show, and the h9k task drive and h9k task start refusals all point at the door; drive and start make no offer themselves\u0022,\u0022The item\\u0027s state, labels, and other fields are untouched; the write is an assignee field update only\u0022,\u0022No sentence says that no flag takes an item from another person, and each says that an interactive confirm at h9k task queue or h9k task assign --take can and that nothing unattended does: the --take help on both commands (which also stops naming only Jira and GitHub), the --claim-gate help on h9k project set, TrackerTake.RefusalLine for HeldByOther, docs/cli.md, docs/scope.md, the CLI reference skill, and the doc comments that state the old rule\u0022,\u0022Every tracker call in these tests runs against recorded responses, and the offer, its decline, and its acceptance, with and without --take and on a Queued task, are pinned through the existing TakeOffer seam without a console\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-30T12:48:29.842991\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"bfa91e3d-c51e-4f65-915a-b590122ab779","originSequence":145519,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-30T12:48:29.853382+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"},{"streamId":"01a1881c-08d6-711f-9733-4b79c75fb837","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1881c-08d6-711f-9733-4b79c75fb837\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022A
